strategies.label: Aggressive Entry
strategies.explanation: Enter closer to the spike once the first reclaim or rejection prints. Higher reward, higher fake-out risk.

strategies.label: Conservative Entry
strategies.explanation: Wait for a full confirmation candle and a clear structure break before committing size.

strategies.label: Breakout Entry
strategies.explanation: Enter on a break and hold beyond the news range high/low after the initial volatility settles.

strategies.label: Pullback Entry
strategies.explanation: Let the first move run, then enter on a controlled pullback into the direction of the bias.
